plain.li: [pactend,cool] The pact is over, then. We part without any grudge.
[pactend,cool,theirLowtech] The oath is put aside as your words ask, and no one here will speak ill of it.
[pactend,cool,theirHightech] Your notice ending the agreement is received and filed.
[pactend,cool,letter] We have your letter, and we will do as it asks.
[pactend,cool,call] Understood, {WRITER}. We'll consider the pact ended.
[pactend,curt] Your colony ends the pact. So be it.
[pactend,curt,theirLowtech] The oath is set aside, as you ask. We will remember who asked.
[pactend,curt,theirHightech] Agreement ended at your request. Our records are updated.
[pactend,curt,call] So that's the end of it, {WRITER}. We heard you.
[trucebyword,cordial,war] Nobody will vouch for an envoy of ours on your land, so take this letter as our word. We accept.
[trucebyword,cordial,war,theirHightech] Terms accepted. With no third party to escort an envoy, consider this letter our signature.
[trucebyword,cool,war] We accept your terms. There is no one to walk our envoy in safely, so our word will have to do.
[trucebyword,cool,war,theirLowtech] Our people swear it here among ourselves, since nobody can bring our envoy to you.
[trucebyword,cool,war,letter] We read your terms twice before we agreed to them. Our word is in this letter, and nowhere else.
[trucebyword,cool,call] All right, {WRITER}. Nobody can vouch for an envoy of ours, so you have our word on this call.
